purpose: Claude/Godot reconstruction handoff; locator geometry plus proposed terrain parameters, not an exact replica or surveyed model
source: User supplied hole diagrams.zip; full descriptions in Augusta_Godot_Build_Brief.md
image_uv_definition: Entire original hole-map-N.jpg: u rightward, v downward, range 0..1. Multiply u by original W and v by original H before measuring or scaling.
outline_provenance: Connected low-saturation sand regions isolated from each full map, then outline simplified and reviewed against the source. No. 12 rear-left uses a smooth estimated edge where canopy obscures it, as flagged per item. Visible sand edge is not the outer turf lip or a recovered hidden boundary.
elevation_status: All numeric heights, profiles, slopes, widths and depths are proposed modeling values; none are recovered survey elevations.
route_status: Approximate golf routing for scale; not a cart path or automatic fairway mask.
water_status: Water locators are not polygons or levels. Trace banks from source; reconcile shared course drainage.
global_assembly: Each hole uses a local independent tee datum. Fit one coherent course terrain from the overall routing map before joining holes.
